scope: Stage 3 offline research and validation only; this contract does not reopen or reinterpret Stage 2.

measurement_rules.length_unit: m unless the metric explicitly states mm
measurement_rules.angle_unit: deg unless the metric explicitly states rad
measurement_rules.spray_off: Spray-OFF samples do not contribute to spray coverage denominators or spray-on performance numerators.
measurement_rules.open_boundary: The open-arch endpoints are clipped boundaries; no wrap-around segment is created.
measurement_rules.invalid_samples: Missing, non-finite, out-of-domain, or failed-validation samples are uncovered and are reported separately.
measurement_rules.threshold_policy: A missing formal threshold is recorded as UNRESOLVED and never inferred from an observed result.

metrics.name: Surface coverage ratio
metrics.definition: Fraction of declared surface evaluation samples hit by at least one valid spray-on footprint.

threshold.reason: No calibrated Stage 3 footprint and acceptance threshold exists yet.

source/provenance: stage3 contract decision; calibrated footprint and acceptance are H2 inputs

metrics.name: Effective spray coverage
metrics.definition: Fraction of declared surface samples covered by a footprint belonging to a spray-on sample that also passes task-pose, kinematic, timing, and collision gates.

threshold.reason: No calibrated deposition model or formal acceptance threshold exists.

metrics.name: Coverage overlap / redundancy
metrics.definition: Fraction of declared surface samples hit by two or more valid spray-on footprints.

threshold.reason: Overlap target is process-dependent and not frozen by Stage 1/2.

metrics.name: Uncovered ratio
metrics.definition: Fraction of declared surface samples with no valid spray-on footprint hit.

threshold.reason: Derived threshold remains unresolved until coverage acceptance is calibrated.

metrics.name: Coverage uniformity
metrics.definition: Clipped complement of the coefficient of variation of calibrated per-surface-sample deposition weight over declared samples; it is not a binary hit ratio.
metrics.formula: U_cov = clip(1 - std(w_i) / mean(w_i), 0, 1), where w_i is calibrated deposition weight and mean(w_i) > 0

threshold.reason: Deposition weight model and acceptance threshold are not available.

source/provenance: stage3 contract decision; no deposition physics is claimed in Stage 2

metrics.name: TCP deviation
metrics.definition: Euclidean distance between the reference TCP target and the actual/planned TCP position in the declared reference frame.
metrics.reference_frame: base_link for the Stage 0/1 baseline; geometry_id surface frame for Stage 3 geometries

metrics.name: Spray distance deviation
metrics.definition: Signed error between the first valid surface intersection along the spray direction and the nominal TCP-to-surface stand-off. Positive means the intersection is farther along the spray direction than nominal.
metrics.formula: e_d_i = 1000 * (dot(p_surface_hit_i - p_TCP_i, s_i) - d_nominal), where s_i is normalized TCP-to-wall spray direction
metrics.reference_frame: declared geometry frame; Stage 0/1 source normals use base_link
source/provenance: config/stage17_pose_repair.yaml:formal_study_constraints.standoff_offset_max_mm=5.0 (task-pose repair offset; distinct from the Stage 0/1 IK stand-off fraction)

metrics.name: Surface-normal deviation
metrics.definition: Angular deviation between the normalized spray axis (+Z of the TCP) and the oriented surface normal. The selected normal orientation is the one aligned with the Stage 0/1 reference normal or, when absent, with the TCP-to-surface spray direction.

metrics.name: TCP Cartesian path length
metrics.definition: Accumulated Euclidean distance between consecutive validated TCP positions; the open path is not closed.
source/provenance: stage3 contract decision; distinct from joint-space travel

metrics.name: Joint-space accumulated travel
metrics.definition: Sum of absolute shortest circular joint deltas between consecutive validated joint states.

metrics.name: Trajectory time
metrics.definition: Elapsed time between the first and last validated trajectory timestamps.

metrics.name: Joint velocity
metrics.definition: Per-joint velocity from the native validated trajectory representation; comparison is against the corresponding MoveIt joint limit.
metrics.formula: v_j(t) = native trajectory velocity_j(t); gate max_t abs(v_j(t)) <= v_limit_j

metrics.name: Joint acceleration
metrics.definition: Per-joint acceleration from the native validated trajectory representation; comparison is against the corresponding MoveIt joint limit.
metrics.formula: a_j(t) = native trajectory acceleration_j(t); gate max_t abs(a_j(t)) <= a_limit_j

metrics.name: Joint jerk
metrics.definition: Official Stage 3 jerk metric is native post-Ruckig trajectory jerk. Analytic interpolation jerk and finite-difference jerk are separate report fields and cannot substitute for the native value when a hard gate is requested.
metrics.formula: j_j(t) = native trajectory jerk_j(t); gate max_t abs(j_j(t)) <= j_limit_j; finite_difference_jerk is report-only unless explicitly promoted by a future contract revision
input: native post-Ruckig jerk or an explicitly identified alternate variant
source/provenance: stage3 contract decision: no jerk variant mixing

metrics.name: State collision
metrics.definition: Collision result for one declared robot state, with self and robot/world results retained separately.

metrics.name: Segment collision
metrics.definition: Collision result over finite joint-space samples between two endpoint states. This is adaptive discrete interpolation, not strict continuous collision detection.
metrics.formula: segment_collision = OR_s collision(q0 + alpha_s * (q1-q0)), with N = max(1, ceil(max_j(abs(delta_q_j))/step_rad)) and alpha_s = s/N

metrics.name: Self collision
metrics.definition: Collision between robot links under the declared AllowedCollisionMatrix at a state or finite segment sample.

metrics.name: Robot-vs-world collision
metrics.definition: Collision between robot geometry and declared world geometry under the declared CollisionEnv and AllowedCollisionMatrix.

metrics.name: Minimum robot-world clearance
metrics.definition: Minimum signed distance returned by the declared collision engine over declared robot states and world objects. Positive means separated, zero means contact, and negative means penetration when the backend supports signed distance.

threshold.reason: No Stage 3 clearance acceptance threshold is frozen; capability availability is qualified separately.

source/provenance: stage3 capability qualification; Stage 2 historical clearance remains null

metrics.name: Minimum self clearance
metrics.definition: Minimum signed distance returned by the declared collision engine between non-allowed robot link pairs over declared robot states.

threshold.reason: No Stage 3 clearance acceptance threshold is frozen; capability availability is qualified separately.

source/provenance: stage3 capability qualification; Stage 2 historical clearance remains null

metrics.name: Planning time
metrics.definition: Wall-clock planning time decomposed into algorithm-only, preprocessing, IK, optimization, and collision-validation components; each component has a fixed timer boundary.
metrics.formula: T_pipeline = T_preprocess + T_IK + T_algorithm + T_optimization + T_collision_validation + T_other, with non-overlapping timer scopes
metrics.reference_frame: host monotonic clock; no robot/controller time
source/provenance: stage3 contract decision; stable timer boundaries are required before algorithm comparison

metrics.name: Spray-ON/OFF performance
metrics.definition: Agreement between declared process-state labels and the planner/controller-independent offline process-state decision at each validated sample, with transition precision/recall reported separately.

threshold.reason: Formal Spray-ON/OFF ML evaluation is explicitly out of H1 scope.

source/provenance: attached Stage 3 H1 request: formal Spray-ON/OFF experiment is not authorized in H1

metrics.name: Generalization to unseen geometry
metrics.definition: Performance of a frozen planner/model on geometries whose geometry_id is absent from training and tuning splits; all primary task metrics are reported without geometry-level leakage.
metrics.formula: G_unseen = aggregate(test_geometry_metrics) with split identity fixed before execution

threshold.reason: No Stage 3 dataset or frozen model exists in H1.

source/provenance: attached Stage 3 H1 request: dataset schema/policy only; no fabricated Stage 3 dataset
